exposure: elevated body mass index (BMI 40 or higher)
outcome: inpatient postpartum permanent contraception by tubal surgery completion
cohort: The study included 2,226 pregnant people who had documented plans for permanent contraception.
finding: After adjusting for multiple comparisons, neither aggregate medical conditions nor specific comorbidities (hypertension, mental health diagnoses, elevated BMI) were significantly associated with inpatient postpartum permanent contraception completion.
